title: Imperial Court Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought he had seen through the entire picture of this imperial court game, the princess's messenger left him frozen in place with words before departing—'Chen Tianming is still alive. Do you believe it?'

text.content: In the Back Mountain of Tianqing Sect, within a hidden cave dwelling shrouded by mist, Chen Ji sat cross-legged. The blood-stained Jade Slip in his hand radiated an eerie red glow under the candlelight. The blood veins on the slip's surface had dried, yet they seemed to pulse faintly, like a dormant heart. Chen Ji probed with his divine sense, and fragments of a blurred inheritance imprint flooded into his mind—scattered words about the lost bloodline of the Chen family, interspersed with 'Imperial Capital,' 'Cage,' 'Key,' and other fragmented terms.

Chen Ji opened his eyes, a cold glint flickering in the depths of his pupils. He had learned from Mo Xiansheng that this Jade Slip was one of the last preparations left by Chen Xuan before his death, containing a world-shaking secret: deep within the imperial court, another branch of the Chen family bloodline still existed. This was the crucial clue for finding Chen Nian. However, the information within the slip had been deliberately sealed; to fully unravel it, he would need to go to the Imperial Capital and engage with key figures of the dynasty.

dialogue.content: 'Young man, the imperial court's waters run far deeper than you can imagine.' Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged hauntingly from the Jade Slip, carrying a weight of gravity. 'The current Emperor appears to control the world, but in truth, he's merely a puppet of various factions. Your search for the Chen family's bloodline will inevitably entangle you in the court's internal struggles. One misstep, and you face utter destruction.'

text.content: A dangerous smile curved Chen Ji's lips. The more perilous the chess game, the more excited he became. Having played the 'useless' role for so long, he excelled at dancing on the blade's edge, carving a path through seemingly fatal situations. Since the imperial court was the key to this game, he would confront those arrogant fools who believed themselves the sole chess masters.

Half a month later, the Imperial Capital. The imperial capital of Great Zhou Dynasty lay in the heart of the Central Plains, its magnificent walls stretching for hundreds of miles. The city's markets thrived, and millions of people gathered here—a truly deserved center of the world. Chen Ji entered the city as a Tianqing Sect disciple on external training, suppressing his aura to the lowest level and perfectly portraying an unremarkable servant disciple. Yet his divine sense was quietly scanning everyone around, searching for a breakthrough point to cut into this imperial court chess game.

dialogue.content: The moment Chen Ji stepped through the Imperial Capital's city gate, his Tianji Record suddenly quivered. A faint, ethereal sense of being watched descended from the void, as if some terrifying existence was gazing at him. Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained unchanged. He completely收敛ed the Tianji Record's aura, pretending nothing had happened and continuing forward. The watching sensation came quickly and left quickly, but Chen Ji knew it was the gaze of the Heavenly Eye—he had been marked.

text.content: On the third day after entering the city, Chen Ji received an invitation from the Crown Prince's mansion. The golden-lettered invitation bore the striking red seal of the Crown Prince's residence, inviting him to a banquet at the Eastern Palace. Chen Ji examined the invitation, a hint of amusement flickering in his eyes. It seemed his reputation as the 'Tianqing Sect waste' had already reached the imperial capital, and those with ulterior motives had begun to notice him. He wondered whether the Crown Prince's mansion had extended this invitation for Tianqing Sect's sake or for the Tianji Record.

Eastern Palace, Crown Prince's mansion. Within the palatial halls adorned with carved beams and painted rafters, a grand banquet was in full swing. Chen Ji, as the invited 'minor sect disciple,' was arranged at the lowest seat—utterly unremarkable. He held his wine cup, his gaze quietly sweeping across everyone present. The Crown Prince sat at the main seat, his features handsome and his smile warm, presenting the perfect image of a crown prince. Yet Chen Ji noticed something: a subtle emptiness lurking in the depths of the Crown Prince's eyes, like a puppet being controlled.

dialogue.content: Halfway through the banquet, the Chief Strategist of the Crown Prince's mansion approached Chen Ji. This person was named Sima Yi, the most trusted advisor beside the Crown Prince, reportedly controlling the entire intelligence network of the Eastern Palace. Sima Yi scrutinized Chen Ji, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his mouth as he lowered his voice: 'Young Master Chen, His Highness the Crown Prince is very interested in Tianqing Sect's cultivation techniques, especially... that incomplete ancient secret manual.'

text.content: Chen Ji coldly smirked inwardly, but on the surface, he displayed only panic. He waved his hands repeatedly, saying: 'You're too kind, sir. Tianqing Sect has no ancient secret manuals at all. I'm just an outer disciple doing杂役 work—I can't even touch the threshold of the Inner Sect. I'm afraid I'll disappoint His Highness the Crown Prince.' His tone was beyond humble, yet Sima Yi's gaze grew increasingly sharp, clearly not believing his words.

choice.prompt: Sima Yi's words carried hidden meanings, hinting that the Crown Prince's mansion had set its sights on the Tianji Record. Facing this naked probe, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Continue feigning weakness, play the act to the end
choices.description: Maintain the waste persona, let the Crown Prince's mansion lower their guard, secretly observe their hidden cards
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as a soft target
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Crown Prince's mansion's trust, get close to core intelligence
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, it will be completely revealed

text.content: Chen Ji continued his act of cowardice, even beads of sweat appearing on his forehead, perfectly depicting a small person panicking after being targeted by someone powerful. Sima Yi narrowed his eyes, seemingly judging whether he was truly a waste or deeply hidden. Finally, he冷笑一声 and turned to leave. Chen Ji lowered his head, yet a barely perceptible smile curved his lips—the fish had taken the bait.

result_nodes.description: Reveal a hint of the Tianji Record's aura, lure the Crown Prince's mansion to make an offer, observe how much they know
result_nodes.visible_cost: Expose part of his trump cards
result_nodes.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on the Crown Prince's mansion's true intentions
result_nodes.risk_hint: May be viewed as prey by the Crown Prince's mansion

text.content: Chen Ji mysteriously glanced around the surroundings, lowering his voice: 'Sir, please don't spread this around. That thing... does indeed have some connection with me.' A sharp glint flashed in Sima Yi's eyes, his smile growing even wider. As their gazes met, Chen Ji caught the fleeting greed in Sima Yi's eyes—the Crown Prince's mansion was determined to obtain the Tianji Record, and they knew far more than he had imagined.

At the end of the banquet, Sima Yi personally escorted Chen Ji out of the mansion. At the corner near the palace gate, Sima Yi suddenly stopped, his voice extremely low: 'Young Master Chen, His Highness the Crown Prince asked me to relay a message to you—the world is about to fall into chaos, the Tianqing Sect cannot protect you, but the Crown Prince's Manor can. As long as you are willing to cooperate, wealth, honor, and martial techniques—all will be yours.'

dialogue.content: As Chen Ji was about to respond, he suddenly sensed a sharp gaze shooting from the shadows. Following that gaze, he saw in a nearby carriage a young woman in splendid attire watching him through the silk curtain. Her face was exquisite, her demeanor cold and arrogant, with a sharp edge in her brows that contrasted starkly with the Crown Prince's gentle nature. A sudden realization struck Chen Ji—this was Princess Xuanhe, the only member of the royal family capable of rivaling the Crown Prince in the entire dynasty.

text.content: After parting from Sima Yi, Chen Ji did not return directly to the inn. Instead, he meandered through the city seven turns and eight bends, confirming no one was following, before quietly arriving at a secluded teahouse. However, he had barely sat down when the door to his private room was gently knocked. A figure in black appeared silently at the entrance, bowing respectfully before handing over a note: 'Young Master Chen, my master requests your presence.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised an eyebrow, unsurprised. If the Princess faction dared to intercept him at the Crown Prince's very gate, it meant they had been tracking him for a considerable time. Following the figure in black through countless winding alleys and concealed passages, Chen Ji arrived before a seemingly modest yet heavily guarded residence. The mansion bore no identifying markers, yet Chen Ji recognized it immediately as Princess Xuanhe's secret base within the Imperial Capital.

text.content: In the mansion's secret chamber, Princess Xuanhe received him personally. Unlike her cold arrogance from the banquet, the Princess's demeanor had softened, yet made her even more difficult to decipher. Examining Chen Ji intently, she suddenly let out a soft laugh. 'Chen Ji, the so-called 'first waste' of the Tianqing Sect's Outer Court disciples, with strength that defies perception, harboring an ancient secret tome capable of overturning the world—am I not correct?'

choice.prompt: The Princess had exposed Chen Ji's disguise right from the start, causing the situation to shift dramatically. How should he respond to such unexpected frankness?

choices.description: Since you've seen through it, there's no need to hide—directly reveal your trump card to gain the Princess's trust
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Princess's trust, approach the core secrets of the dynasty
choices.risk_hint: The Princess may have ulterior motives

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, cupping his hands: 'Your Highness truly has discerning eyes. Indeed, I do possess a fragment of an ancient secret tome, but what exactly it is... I suspect Your Highness wants to know more than I do.' A glint of appreciation flashed in Princess Xuanhe's eyes. 'You're quite candid. Far more so than those hesitating men.'

choices.text: Continue to deny, turn the tables
choices.description: Question the Princess's intelligence sources, pointing out her information may be flawed or manipulated
choices.visible_reward: Probe whether other forces are manipulating the Princess from behind the scenes
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity for cooperation

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head with a bitter smile: 'Your Highness's information channels seem to have some issues. If I truly possessed such a treasure, how would I have ended up in this state today?' However, his tone shifted, his eyes suddenly sharp. 'But... today's invitation surely wasn't just to relay such rumors, was it?'

text.content: Princess Xuanhe dismissed her attendants, personally pouring Chen Ji a cup of tea, her voice dropping several tones. 'Chen Ji, I know you're searching for someone.' Chen Ji's hand holding the teacup trembled imperceptibly, though he quickly regained composure. The Princess continued, 'That person is Chen Nian, your long-lost sister. She... is imprisoned in an extremely hidden location.'

Chen Ji's heart tightened, yet his expression remained impassive. He set down his teacup, his gaze steady as he met the Princess's eyes. 'What does Your Highness want?' Princess Xuanhe smiled gracefully: 'Direct! I appreciate working with intelligent people.' She rose and walked to the window, gazing at the Imperial Capital beneath the night sky. 'Behind the Crown Prince's Manor stands the Xuanwu Sect. They aim to use the Tianji Record to unlock the Ancient Forbidden Land, seeking an earth-shaking fortune. And I need you to help me disrupt this game.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji furrowed his brow: 'And Your Highness's conditions?' Princess Xuanhe turned, her eyes blazing intensely: 'The conditions are simple—I want you to help me overthrow the Crown Prince. In exchange, not only will I reveal Chen Nian's whereabouts, but I'll mobilize the full power of the Princess's Manor to help rescue her.' She paused, adding meaningfully, 'Of course, if you could lend me a glimpse of the Tianji Record, that would be even better.'

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head in contemplation, his mind racing. The Princess's words seemed tempting, yet were full of flaws. First, how could she possibly know Chen Nian's whereabouts so precisely? Second, the Xuanwu Sect behind the Crown Prince? Hmph, those simple-minded Xuanwu Sect fellows had no capacity for orchestrating such an intricate scheme. The true mastermind was someone else entirely.

choice.prompt: The Princess's proposal was riddled with suspicions. Chen Ji had to make a choice: pretend to believe and enter the dragon's den, or directly expose her lies?

choices.description: Agree to cooperate with the Princess, infiltrate the core of dynastic power, and uncover the true nature of all factions
choices.visible_cost: May fall into an even greater crisis
choices.visible_reward: Obtain core intelligence of the imperial dynasty and find clues about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: All forces may turn against you

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then finally nodded: "Your Highness's proposal, Chen can consider. However, before that, I need some... sincerity." A hint of satisfaction flickered in Princess Xuanhe's eyes as she took a token from her sleeve and pushed it toward him, "This is the passage token of the princess manor. You may use it to mobilize any hidden agent of the princess manor within the capital. In three days, we shall discuss the details."

result_nodes.description: Point out the flaws in the princess's words, forcing her to reveal her true hand and background forces
result_nodes.visible_reward: Obtain more real intelligence, seize the initiative in negotiations

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, interrupting the princess: "Your Highness, let me give you some advice—next time you spin a lie, at least patch up the holes. The Crown Prince has Xuanwu Sect behind him? Do you even believe that yourself?" Princess Xuanhe's expression shifted slightly, but she did not deny it. Chen Ji continued: "I suppose the one standing behind Your Highness is even more mysterious than the Crown Prince's backer, no?"

text.content: A brief silence fell over the secret chamber. Princess Xuanhe stared at Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly laughed—the sound crisp yet carrying a chill: "Interesting, Chen Ji. You are indeed much more entertaining than the rumors suggested." She suppressed her smile, her expression turning grave, "Since you've guessed it, I won't hide it from you. The one behind the Crown Prince is indeed not Xuanwu Sect—but the Heavenly Fate Alliance."

Chen Ji's pupils constricted slightly. The Heavenly Fate Alliance—this name, he had heard something of from Mo Xiansheng. That was the most deeply hidden force behind the imperial dynasty, said to be composed of retired emperors and core royal family members from successive generations, specifically tasked with handling affairs that could not bear the light of day. If the Crown Prince truly had connections to the Heavenly Fate Alliance, then this chess game was far more complex than imagined.

dialogue.content: Princess Xuanhe continued: "The Heavenly Fate Alliance was originally founded to safeguard the stability of the imperial dynasty. But over hundreds of years, this organization has long since become corrupted. They secretly manipulate the court, purge dissenters, and even have unspeakable connections with certain existences in the Ancient Forbidden Land." She looked at Chen Ji, "And the Tianji Record in your hands is exactly the sacred artifact they have coveted for ages."

text.content: Chen Ji finally understood. So whether it was the Crown Prince's faction or the princess's faction, they were merely two chess pieces in the Heavenly Fate Alliance's layout. Their true objective was to use the overt struggle between these two forces to secretly collect the ancient secret codes scattered throughout the mortal world—including his Tianji Record. And the place where Chen Nian was imprisoned was most likely under the Heavenly Fate Alliance's control as well.

Chen Ji rose to his feet, walked to the window, gazing at the bustling night scene of the capital, yet his eyes were ice-cold. This chess game grew larger and larger, with more and more players, but Chen Ji had never feared a chess game. The more complex the situation, the more chaotic the board, the more it became the stage for someone of his strategic caliber. The Heavenly Fate Alliance wanted to make him a chess piece? Then he would become the Chess Player himself, pulling the Heavenly Fate Alliance down from the board!

He turned around, looked at Princess Xuanhe, and suddenly wore a meaningful smile: "Your Highness, I have a proposal." Princess Xuanhe raised an eyebrow: "Speak." Chen Ji stepped closer, lowering his voice: "You and I cooperate—no longer a dispute between the Crown Prince and the princess, but the two of us, jointly opposing the Heavenly Fate Alliance." He paused, "After the matter is done, you may read the Tianji Record for three days. In exchange, you must truthfully tell me Chen Nian's whereabouts."

Princess Xuanhe was silent for a long while before finally extending her hand: "Deal." Chen Ji struck palms with her as a vow, the force in his palm just right—expressing sincerity while secretly concealing a blade. This deal seemed fair, yet both parties had their own hidden intentions—the princess wanted to use his hand against the Heavenly Fate Alliance, while he wanted to use the princess's power to find Chen Nian. As for who would ultimately prevail, that would depend on whose chess skills were higher.

At the moment of parting, Princess Xuanhe suddenly called out to him: "Chen Ji, one last thing." She took a small jade bottle from her sleeve and handed it to him, "This is an elixir I obtained from an ancient ruin, called 'Reversing Fate Elixir.' It is said to be specifically used to oppose the will of Heaven." Chen Ji took the jade bottle, his gaze sharpening. The princess continued: "I know you are searching for Chen Nian, and also searching for your father Chen Tianming. This elixir may be of help."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's heart shook, though his expression remained unmoved: "Chen Tianming?" Princess Xuanhe gave him a meaningful look: "Do you think your father's disappearance back then was that simple?" She paused, her voice extremely low, "He is still alive, imprisoned in the most core forbidden grounds of the Heavenly Fate Alliance—the Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets. And that place is precisely where the Eye of Heavenly Fate descends to the mortal realm." With that, she turned and left, leaving only silence in the room.

text.content: Chen Ji stood where he was, clutching the jade bottle tightly, his heart churning with monstrous waves. His father was still alive—this information completely shattered his original plans. He had originally only wanted to find Chen Nian, yet he never expected such an astonishing truth to be hidden behind it all. The Eye of Heavenly Fate, the Chen bloodline, the Tianji Record... all the clues pointed to the same place: the Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets. At this moment, he finally realized that his ultimate confrontation with the Eye of Heavenly Fate was probably coming far sooner than he had anticipated.

Night wind blew into the secret chamber. Chen Ji put away the jade bottle, a resolute glint flashing in his eyes. No matter how dangerous the road ahead, no matter how powerful the opponents, he would go to the end. His father was waiting for him, his sister was waiting for him, and the Eye of Heavenly Fate that had orchestrated schemes across countless ages—he would personally pull it down from its divine throne. The imperial power struggle was merely the beginning; the true chess game had just begun to unfold.
